paragraphs: Over the past 20 years I have worked with countless companies in the dental industry. These are the ones I trust most.
Questions about any of them? Email me at len@drlentau.com or call my cell at 215‑292‑2100.

note.label: Full disclosure:
note.text: I serve as General Manager of Birdeye's dental division. Some companies on this page sponsor my podcast or events, pay me a referral fee, or give my contacts a discount.
